name: split-reveal
title: Split Reveal
description: Words or letters rise out of their own masks and sharpen from a blur, on mount or scroll into view.

props.name: text
props.description: The text. Screen readers read it as one string.

props.name: split
props.description: Reveal word by word or letter by letter.

props.name: blur
props.description: Starting blur in pixels. 0 turns the blur off.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the animation off and renders plain text.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
